title: Client next-delivery preview mirrors backend schedule; comment pointers must stay in sync
answers: Where is the subscription next delivery date computed?
Changing subscription scheduling logic, what else must I update?
Client preview of next delivery date differs from server
body:
The authoritative schedule is `Subscription.set_next_delivery_date` in `products/exports/backend/models/subscription.py`; the client preview mirror is `getNextDeliveryDate` in `products/subscriptions/frontend/components/Subscriptions/nextDeliveryDate.ts`.
- Backend comment in `set_next_delivery_date` names the frontend file; update it if the function moves again.
- Schedule rule changes (RRULE fields, frequency, bysetpos, byweekday) should be reflected in both places.
- Known existing gaps in the preview (not fixed here): it ignores `count`/`until_date` and the server's 15-minute scheduling buffer.
- Note the comment inside nextDeliveryDate.ts still cites the older path `posthog/models/subscription.py`.
applies: Subscription scheduling changes across backend model and frontend editor preview
